sentences.Barna her i landet begynner på skolen de: Children in this country start school in the year they turn six.
sentences.Barnetrinnet varer i sju år og ungdomstr: Primary school lasts seven years and lower secondary three years.
sentences.Barnetrinnet og ungdomstrinnet til samme: Together, primary and lower secondary are called grunnskolen, the compulsory school.
sentences.Grunnskolen er obligatorisk, og skolen e: Compulsory school is mandatory, and school is free.
sentences.Etter grunnskolen kan elevene begynne på: After compulsory school the pupils can start upper secondary school.
sentences.Alle har rett til en plass i videregåend: Everyone has the right to a place in upper secondary education, and almost everyone stays on at school after compulsory school.
sentences.På videregående skole må man velge mello: At upper secondary school you have to choose between different programmes.
sentences.Hvis man vil utdanne seg til et praktisk: If you want to train for a practical trade, you choose a vocational programme.
sentences.Undervisningen er en kombinasjon av teor: The teaching is a combination of theory and practice.
sentences.Etter to år på skolen kan man ha arbeids: After two years at school you can do work placement in a company for two years.
sentences.Da blir man kvalifisert til å jobbe som: Then you become qualified to work as a hairdresser, carpenter, electrician, mechanic, cook, child and youth worker or in other practical trades.
sentences.Hvis man vil studere ved universitet ell: If you want to study at a university or university college after upper secondary school, you choose a programme that prepares you for higher education, with more focus on theory.
